screens.name: Welcome
screens.goal: Start without knowing notation or MIDI.
actions: Choose instrument context without permission prompt
Returning user goes to S02, never repeats mandatory onboarding
screens.data: Local preferences and route availability; no account.
screens.acceptance: A novice reaches the first useful action in at most three deliberate actions from first launch.

screens.name: Home
screens.goal: Know what to do next and resume.
screens.primary: Continue saved lesson or start First Motif
screens.data: Saved arrangementVersion, lessonVersion, step, range and hints.
screens.acceptance: Resume preserves exact step/range/settings; no fabricated completion percentage.

screens.name: Music
screens.goal: Choose available material, not pretend to search the entire internet.
screens.acceptance: Unavailable title shows honest no-results and import/example actions; no scraped catalog.

screens.name: Import
screens.goal: Safely add a supported local file.
screens.data: Import diagnostic report, checksum and supported capability subset.
screens.acceptance: Unsupported semantics never lead to a normal playable result; cancelling preserves library.

screens.name: ArrangementOverview
screens.goal: Understand the chosen version and how to begin.
screens.primary: Learn this fragment or open free practice
screens.data: ArrangementId in query, exact source and capabilities.
screens.acceptance: Practice-only imports never claim an automatically prepared full course.

screens.name: LearningPath
screens.goal: See why each short step matters.
screens.data: Authored lesson DAG and learner evidence.
screens.acceptance: No cycles/dead-end locks; skipped status remains distinct.

screens.name: Lesson
screens.goal: Understand one idea, hear it, try it.
screens.primary: Listen then Try as distinct actions
screens.data: LessonStep reference with verified notes and evidence basis.
screens.acceptance: Listening alone does not complete a performance task; one primary next instruction.

screens.name: Practice
screens.goal: Practice a bounded phrase with understandable controls.
screens.primary: Listen / Try / Pause according to actual mode
screens.acceptance: No control overlays sounding score; no stuck notes; no automatic correct result; exact range survives resize.

screens.name: Reflection
screens.goal: Choose a useful next practice action.
screens.primary: Continue or Retry based on reflection
screens.data: Attempt record with basis; no unsupported metrics.
screens.acceptance: Save error does not falsely show saved; playback duration not scored as skill.

screens.name: Library
screens.goal: Find and manage owned local material.
actions: Delete local arrangement after explicit scope confirmation
screens.acceptance: Removing cached media does not silently remove progress; deleting arrangement explains consequences.

screens.name: Learn
screens.goal: Find the basics already connected to practice.
screens.acceptance: Future topics not represented as playable fake courses; no mandatory huge linear syllabus.

screens.name: Progress
screens.goal: Understand practice history without inflated mastery claims.
screens.primary: Practice recommended weak or due step
screens.data: Attempt history and step states, not an arbitrary global player level.
screens.acceptance: No percentage accuracy for self-report; input-specific results not merged misleadingly.

screens.name: Settings
screens.goal: Control language, assistance, sound and data.
screens.data: Versioned preferences; no hidden server profile.
screens.acceptance: Changing language never changes pitch; unsupported installation has accurate manual guidance.

screens.name: InstrumentSetup
screens.goal: Choose available feedback with informed permissions.
screens.primary: Use self-report or explicitly Connect MIDI when implemented
actions: Request supported MIDI access on click
screens.data: Runtime capability and actual input events only.
screens.acceptance: In alpha MIDI can be explicitly not-yet-implemented; no green connected state fabricated.

screens.name: TheoryOverlay
screens.goal: Explain the current symbol without losing the musical context.
screens.primary: Try example or return to the same position
actions: Close and restore focus without autoplay
screens.acceptance: Opening pauses practice; closing never changes step/range or auto-starts sound.

screens.name: DataManagement
screens.goal: Back up and recover local progress safely.
actions: Reset local data with explicit confirmation
screens.data: Versioned backup manifest and content inventory.
screens.acceptance: Corrupt/newer backup never overwrites data; reset is deliberate; no cloud-sync claim.
